name: Walschensaal
kurzbeschreibung: A breathtaking rock gorge in the hintere Kaunertal, roaring with cascading waters and towering cliffs.
beschreibung:
Currently, no excursion destination named Walschensaal can be found in the Kaunertal; neither the Tourismusverband Tiroler Oberland nor the municipality of Kaunertal list such an entry. The present entry describes a wild, deeply incised gorge near Feichten, through which a stream cascades over several waterfalls, as well as a narrow, well-secured hiking trail with several viewpoints along the gorge. Contact and opening hours information is therefore deliberately left open.

Feichten is the main village of the municipality of Kaunertal in the district of Landeck and lies at 1,287 metres above sea level in the nature park and glacier region. The Kaunertal extends from Prutz to the Kaunertaler Gletscher; the Tourismusverband Tiroler Oberland, based in Feichten, manages the region. An independent route or facility named Walschensaal could not be confirmed in publicly accessible sources, therefore only the data from this entry itself and generally known regional data are reproduced here.
